failure_summary.description: Returned only part of a conventional multiword title or personal name instead of the full identifying form.
Selected a related detail instead of the explicit target: a subnational region instead of the country, and a written statement instead of its author.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs agents to preserve full identifying names, follow the clue's requested target and scope, and use head nouns and pronouns to select the answer slot. These failures indicate nonadherence rather than a clear missing rule; adding similar guidance would duplicate existing content, and a comparable name-form edit was rejected previously.
